title: Product Manager, New Products
description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE'RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!
At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.
Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.
Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.
As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!
💡 YOUR MISSION
You’ll own a significant product area, working closely with design and engineering to turn complex problems into mission critical products care teams rely on every day. We’re hiring for a few key roles in our platform - as we get to know each other we’ll match you to a vertical.
You’ll get close to care teams, understand the systems behind their work, and turn that knowledge into product direction. We’re looking for someone who learns deeply, ships consistently, and raises the quality of product decisions around them.
🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE
 - Become an expert in your users’ work. Spend time alongside nurses and care teams. Understand their problems well enough to represent their needs and challenge your own assumptions.
 - Ship, learn, and follow through. Turn ideas into prototypes and useful releases. Stay close after launch to understand what people adopt, where they struggle, and whether their work gets easier.
 - Build for the global market. Find the common needs beneath local workflows. Ensure that market teams can move fast and localize the product while keeping fundamental patterns shared when it makes sense.
 - Go deep on the system. Understand how the product works, from the user experience to data, integrations, and agent behavior. Work through technical trade-offs with engineering.
 - Shape strategy from first principles. Question inherited assumptions, identify opportunities, and make clear choices about what to build—and what to leave out.
 - Measure what matters. Define success before building. Use product data, customer insight, and quality measures to guide development and change direction when the evidence calls for it.
 - Raise the product bar. Bring original thinking, clear reasoning, and strong execution. Lead by example and help the product org level up through your work and feedback.
🤝 YOUR SKILLSET - WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE
 - A track record of owning substantial products from an unclear problem through launch and sustained adoption. Bonus if you’ve worked with complex regulated environments.
 - Strong product judgment and attention to detail. You connect long-term direction to the small decisions that make a product useful and intuitive.
 - Technical fluency and the curiosity to understand systems in depth. You can reason through decisions with engineers and connect them to customer needs.
 - A working understanding of how AI agents use context, tools, and feedback to get things done and where they fail. You can help design workflows around those capabilities, with thoughtful evaluation, permissions, and human oversight.
 - Hands-on use of AI to prototype and test ideas. You don’t need to have shipped an AI product already, but you should have a clear point of view on how AI changes what we can build and how we build it.
 - The ability to create direction in ambiguous situations and bring people with you through clear communication and follow-through.
 - Curiosity about care and a willingness to learn alongside the people doing it. Healthcare experience is valuable, but isn’t a requirement.
 - German is a strong advantage but is not required.
🎯 OUR SUCCESS MINDSET - HOW WE WORK AT VOIZE
 - You own the outcome: You have a bias to action, resilience, and rapid learning in ambiguous environments.
 - You put the user first: Deep empathy for care teams and the operators who manage them.
 - You are data-driven and detail-oriented: You make decisions based on evidence, and hold a high bar for accuracy in agent output.
 - You value open communication and constructive feedback: You contribute to a positive team culture and challenge the status quo.
🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE
 - Become a co‑creator of our success with stock options
 - Hybrid work from our Berlin office
 - Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses
 - Regular team events and on‑sites, an open culture, and real ownership from day one
✨ READY TO TALK? APPLY NOW! 🚀
We're looking for product people with passion, desire to learn, and an entrepreneurial mindset. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.
Your skills and experience will stand out, especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. voize welcomes people from all different backgrounds to apply.
We're excited to hear from you!

title: Product Builder (Mid/Senior)
location: Remote, Almaty, Limassol, Barcelona, Serbia, Portugal
description:
About The Role
 We’re looking for a Product Builder for  Customer Care : a product person with real technical depth and an AI-first mindset, who wants to build our customer-facing support systems with us, not just run them. You’ll own all of Customer Care’s conversational systems: the chatbot today and voice/phone support next.
This is an individual contributor role, and you own problems end to end. You work out the product side: what’s actually broken, what to build, how we’ll know it worked. Then you build it yourself with AI coding agents, engineers review, and you take it to production. You own the result end to end. 
Your Mission
 Own Customer Care’s conversational systems (chat, voice/phone, knowledge base, tool integrations) from 0 to 1: decide what to build, why, and how to measure success, then take it through launch and iteration.
 Design the system: RAG and what goes into the knowledge base, guardrails, agent architecture, routing, tools, internal-system actions, handoff. Know the trade-offs well enough to challenge engineering proposals with solid arguments.
 Build it yourself: dig into the data, design the solution, build it with AI coding agents, test it on real conversations, and ship to production with engineering review.
 Write, test, and iterate prompts, skills, and knowledge so the bot answers correctly, acts safely, and sounds like us; build evals that catch regressions before every release.
 Run A/B tests of models, prompts and flows, define success metrics upfront, and shut down what doesn’t work.
 Scale self-service: deflection up and cost-to-serve down without hurting CSAT. Define “resolved” and “valid handoff” and monitor deflection, handoff reasons, resolution quality, CSAT, handling time, and cost per conversation.
 Challenge the rules around the bot, not just the bot: when escalation policies, back-office processes or missing tools block resolution, build the case and get them changed.
 Prioritise ruthlessly and pull in Engineering, Analytics, QA, Operations and business owners when the work needs them.
Your Profile
 4+ years taking products or features from a problem to a measurable result, in any function: product, engineering, analytics, operations.
 Proven track record of shipping things to real users and owning the outcome.
 You build with AI coding agents every day and take your own changes to production. Show us something you shipped.
 Real technical depth in LLM systems: RAG, guardrails, agent architecture, evals, prompt and conversation design. You understand APIs, data and system architecture well enough to design and debug.
 Comfortable with git, PRs and code review.
 Strong analytical skills: comfortable with data, metrics, and decisions under uncertainty.
 Clear communicator in English: you explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
 Self-directed: you don’t wait for someone to tell you what matters.
 Nice to have 
 Background in customer support, conversation design, or prompt engineering.
 Side projects with LLM APIs, agents, or automation. Show us.
 Fintech or banking support: cards, transfers, chargebacks, KYC/AML restrictions, account closure.
 Experience with LLM observability tools (Langfuse or similar) and helpdesk platforms (Kustomer, Zendesk).
 Voice/telephony stacks (STT, TTS, turn detection) for phone support.
Why Join Vivid?
 We have a hybrid model in our offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
 We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
 AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
 Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
 Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
 Sports compensation. 
 Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.
Compensation range
 Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.
About Vivid
 At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.
Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.
Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.
We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

title: Product Manager, Technical
description:
Rithum ™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimise operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.
 Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimised consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.
 Overview 
 As a Technical Product Manager, you support and drive strategic product initiatives. You quickly build a clear understanding of platform technical capabilities and limitations to translate business needs into precise requirements. You help manage projects from planning through launch, maintaining end-to-end ownership across roadmap development, release readiness, and post-launch enablement. You work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Client Success teams to prioritize and deliver impactful solutions. You use data, client feedback, and market insights to make informed product decisions, improve product value, and support successful adoption.
 Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.
 Responsibilities 
 Support Senior Product Manager across strategic operations workstreams.
 Translate business priorities into clear technical product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans, leading scoping calls and producing crisp written outputs.
 Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Client Success to define, prioritize, and deliver high-impact capabilities.
 Drive execution across discovery, planning, development, testing, release, and post-launch iteration, taking end-to-end ownership of roadmap development projects from requirements through delivery, release readiness, and post-development documentation and enablement.
 Establish and maintain an intake and triage rhythm for enhancement requests and operational work, ensuring consistent capture of context, impact, dependencies, and recommended priority for leadership decisions.
 Build and maintain a prioritized view of top platform risks and recurring operational gaps, surfacing risks early and clearly to product leadership to support prioritization decisions.
 Manage cross-functional alignment, dependencies, timelines, risks, and status reporting across multiple initiatives.
 Analyze data, client feedback, and market signals to inform product decisions and improve feature value.
 Oversee product documentation, release notes, internal enablement materials, and stakeholder communications.
 Support client and internal team discussions to clarify requirements, validate use cases, and ensure successful adoption.
 Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) to accelerate and elevate outcomes, including communication drafting, data analysis, prompt engineering, and documentation.
 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 2+ years of Technical Product Management or Product Management experience at a software company.
 Experience working on ecommerce or marketplace products.
 Experience working closely with Engineering and Data Science teams on APIs, data workflows, analytics, or automation capabilities.
 Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous requests into clear requirements (user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation) and drive work to completion across cross-functional teams.
 Experience reading and interpreting API requirements and technical documentation (REST concepts, authentication patterns, payloads, and webhooks fundamentals).
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelors or Advanced degree in a related field.
 Experience with the Rithum for Brands (ChannelAdvisor) platform.
 Intrapreneurial/founder mindset.
 Experience with AI tooling for documentation, requirements gathering, and/or building solutions.
 Integration-heavy environment exposure (APIs, webhooks).
 Experience using tooling commonly associated with technical delivery and operations (JIRA, Notion, backlog tools, documentation tooling, and basic data analysis).
 Travel Required 
 Up to 10%
 Other Duties 
 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

 When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

title: Product Manager Insurance (m/w/d)
description:
* Vollzeit
Berlin
**Finanzfluss – Wir machen Menschen zu finanziellen Selbstentscheidern.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
Wir glauben, dass Geld gut ist. Du auch? Dann werde Teil unserer Community. Diese besteht aus finanzinteressierten Menschen und erreicht jeden Monat über unsere Website, Social Media, den Newsletter und Podcast ein Millionenpublikum. Zusammen mit unserer Community entstehen ständig neue Ideen, die wir mit großer Freude umsetzen.
Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen das erforderliche Wissen einfach zugänglich zu machen und sie damit zu ermutigen, ihre finanzielle Zukunft aktiv selbst zu gestalten.
**Dein Impact**
---------------
Bei Versicherungen ist es schwer zu erkennen, was man wirklich braucht und was ein Tarif leistet. Wir wollen das ändern: mit eigenen Tarifnoten, ohne Einfluss von Versicherern auf Bewertung und Ranking und mit dem ehrlichen Hinweis, wenn jemand eine Versicherung nicht braucht. Woran man uns messen kann, steht in unserem Code of Conduct.
Die ersten Vergleiche sind live und werden von unserer Community bereits genutzt. Dein Ziel ist es, sie zur ersten Anlaufstelle für Versicherungen zu machen, so wie Finanzfluss es bei der Geldanlage für viele schon ist.
**Deine Aufgaben**
------------------
* Du verantwortest unsere Versicherungsvergleiche vom ersten Klick bis zum Vertragsabschluss und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Nutzer immer das passende Produkt finden.
* Du verbindest Vergleiche und Copilot zu einem durchgängigen Versicherungserlebnis, in dem Abschlüsse messbar im Copilot landen.
* Du entwickelst die Roadmap für deinen Bereich und stellst sicher, dass Verbesserungen pünktlich live gehen und ihr Erfolg an KPIs wie Conversion Rate und NPS messbar wird.
* Du nutzt Daten und Nutzerinterviews um herauszufinden, was unsere Nutzer wirklich brauchen und leitest daraus konsequent Produktentscheidungen ab.
* Du testest Ideen schnell mit Prototypen und setzt Produktverbesserungen mit KI-Tools selbst um.
* Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Redaktion und dem Versicherungsteam zusammen, behältst Compliance im Blick und unterstützt den Lead Insurance bei Partnerverhandlungen und Strategie.
**Deine Skills**
----------------
* Du hast in deinen bisherigen Stationen herausragende Ergebnisse erzielt, idealerweise im Produktmanagement, gerne aber auch im Consulting, bei einem Fintech, Insurtech oder in einem anderen High-Pace-Umfeld.
* Du arbeitest hands-on mit AI und hast damit schon selbst Features oder Prototypen umgesetzt.
* Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue, komplexe Themen ein. Versicherungswissen bringst du mit oder eignest es dir an.
* Du hast ein Gespür für gute Produkte, denkst analytisch und strukturiert und triffst auf Basis von Daten und Nutzerfeedback klare Entscheidungen.
* Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse und bringst Dinge in hohem Tempo ins Ziel, auch wenn der Weg nicht vorgezeichnet ist.
* Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau oder als Muttersprache.
**Wir bieten dir**
------------------
* Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit kompetitivem Vergütungspaket inklusive Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg (VSOP).
* Volle Ownership für einen Bereich, den du von Anfang an mitprägst.
* Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Growth Lead Insurance und den Gründern, mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
* Entwicklungschancen und Gestaltungsspielraum in einem stark wachsenden und profitablen Startup.
* Modernste Tools und Arbeitsumgebung in unserem Office in Berlin-Kreuzberg.
* Ein zielstrebiges Team und eine großartige Community
Interessiert?
Bei uns zählst du. Bei Finanzfluss feiern wir Vielfalt und sind überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Hintergründe uns als Team stärker machen. Deshalb heißen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, körperlichen Fähigkeiten oder Familienstand herzlich willkommen. Wenn du dich von dieser Stelle angesprochen fühlst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Senior Product Manager – Pricing, Packaging & Positioning (m/f/d)
description:
**This is femtasy**
femtasy is the audio-only streaming platform for sensual audio stories & sexy sounds for women. We inspire women to explore and enjoy on their own terms. We're a female-centric product, led by a female CEO & Founder, with over 80% of our team identifying as women+. We've already positively impacted the lives of hundreds of thousands of women by redefining female pleasure – and we're just getting started.
**The role:**
Our Head of Product Growth is going on parental leave for about a year, and we are looking for a senior product person to step into the role for 15 months, including on- and offboarding time for a proper handover in both directions.
Your main focus will be our most important strategic initiative for 2027: **pricing, packaging and positioning**. Over the next 15 months, we want to rethink how we package, communicate and price femtasy. You will take this from research to a rolled-out offer and iterations.
Paywall and pricing page optimisation will be part of the job, but the role goes well beyond it. We are looking for someone who sees pricing as part of the value proposition, who asks "what do we offer, to whom, and how do we talk about it?" — and then also makes sure the paywall turns that into conversions.
At the same time, you will be the product owner of the user journey across web and app, so you also need to enjoy rolling up your sleeves and getting things shipped across funnels, conversion rate optimization, campaigning, landing pages, checkout and onboarding flows.
**What you'll do**
* **Own pricing and packaging end to end.** Turn pricing research into concrete tiers, offers, pricing pages and paywalls, and build and execute the roll-out plan.
* **Shape product positioning.** Define how we position femtasy for different personas and use cases, together with the marketing teams, who own execution in ads and campaigns.
* **Run experiments independently.** Plan, set up and QA A/B tests on pricing pages, landing pages, checkout and funnels (we use VWO), and make sure tracking, UTMs and attribution are solid enough to trust the results.
* **Work closely with Data.** Design tests together with our Head of Data, including guardrail metrics and cannibalisation analysis, and dig into the data yourself.
* **Be hands-on with Tech.** Write clear tickets, run refinements, and QA your own launches.
* **Look after the product and user journey.** Keep an eye on the overall experience, flag issues, and decide what needs attention when new topics come up.
* **Keep the bigger picture in view.** Pricing, pages, checkout, tracking, CRM and marketing are all connected. You understand what a change in one place does to the others.
**What you bring**
* Several years of product experience (product management, product growth, product marketing or monetisation), with **hands-on experience in subscription pricing and packaging**, ideally in consumer subscriptions or digital products or apps.

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.
 Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.
 When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.
 Technical Project Manager (Platform) at BairesDev
 As a Technical Project Manager (Platform), you will lead the execution of complex platform-driven initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams and managing technical dependencies. You will streamline delivery processes and ensure that engineering teams remain unblocked and aligned with organizational goals through efficient, high-impact coordination.
 What You'll Do:
 - Drive project execution by managing dependencies, stakeholders, and delivery plans across multiple platform teams.
 - Maintain and share deep platform knowledge to facilitate smooth technical coordination and ensure accurate project documentation.
 - Prioritize asynchronous communication and documentation to ensure efficient project flow while minimizing the need for synchronous meetings.
 - Track technical requirements, progress, and dependencies using JIRA, Confluence, and JQL.
 - Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks to unblock development teams and ensure the timely delivery of platform features.
 - Manage high-quality project documentation and stakeholder communication using Slack and Google Workspace.
 What we are looking for:
 - 4+ years of experience in Technical Project Management, specifically within platform or infrastructure engineering environments.
 - Proven expertise in driving project execution by managing complex dependencies and delivery plans across multiple teams.
 - Proficiency in using JIRA and Confluence for project tracking, documentation, and managing team workflows via JQL.
 - Strong background in facilitating asynchronous communication and coordination using tools like Slack and Google Workspace.
 - Demonstrated ability to maintain platform knowledge and unblock engineering teams.
 - Advanced proficiency in English.
 How we do make your work (and your life) easier:
 - 100% remote work (from anywhere).
 - Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
 - Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
 - Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
 - Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.
 - Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
 - Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.
 Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!
